description: This PHP source file defines the ImportForm class for handling language translation file imports in Drupal. It includes form building, validation, and submission logic for uploading translation files, managing language creation, and batch processing.

classes.name: ImportForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for importing translation files, managing language creation, and batch processing of translation data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the form with module handler and language manager services.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the translation import form with file upload, language selection, and options.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission: processes uploaded file, creates language if needed, and initiates batch translation processing.
